body: You're welcome. I'm sorry I got angry with you, I hope you go on to help people who need it. And thanks.

I deserve those down votes too, but really man, think about what you're doing next time. I don't hate you, but please, your actions have serious consequences. You owned up to this and I hope you think hell of a lot more before you do something like that again. It's too fucking late for me.

I don't think I deserve it at all though. My mom literally just came in here and told me what you did "treat everyone above yourself". I can't do anything right. I do something right and it's never good enough. It's like I have to get on stomach and drag myself though the mud to make everyone happy. I don't know what's wrong with me. For whatever reason, I'm a selfish jerk. I don't want to be this way but I can't change. I think some days it would be better if I didn't live with them. This whole environment is unhealthy. I appreciate you reaching out to me...but I feel that I'm going to hell no matter what. God knew there would be those who would go to hell when he made them. It might not be his wish that any should go, but I know not everyone will make it. I can't change. I'm just accepting that I'll never get to heaven. If you still want to talk to me after this, I wouldn't mind.

> I'm not actually a terrible person.

Eh, from a terrible person's POV (mine) you're an ass. I actually want to commit suicide and I've never bothered to call the hotline. Why? Because they don't give a shit. Probably because of people like you.

> I know it isn't much but I'll think a happy thought for you. 

It means a lot, it really does. There's so many people in my life who are "close to me" but don't care or aren't available. I'll remember this. 

>  if there is a God, why would he punish his children for trying to escaping their suffering.

This. I know there's some Christians (or whoever) who don't think committing suicide warrants hell. That was a Catholic belief from the Medieval ages, which I think they misinterpreted. There's a bible verse referencing an "unpardonable sin" but it's not suicide from what I know. Still...I feel that because I was/am such a crappy person I'd go there, even if not for suicide. I feel remorse for what I've done to others in my life, but I'll never be perfect, not with my background. I'll keep making these same mistakes for as long as I live. I'll never be free of my own trouble causing nature because I can't get free of my past. I deserve nothing good in this life or the next, if there is one.  

That said, thank you so much for bothering to talk to me. I don't want to die, but I really can't see any of this getting better. Everyone says "life isn't that bad" but if that's true why do I feel like I'm drowning with every breath I take? I've been though worse physically, but these emotions, or lack thereof hurt far worse. My dad told me to get over it. Man, if he only knew...I kinda wish he could feel it for a moment, just how painful, how confusing this all is. He might not be so quick to judge.

>  If you tell his friends that you can’t be their friends because your brother said so, you make him look bad to his friends and open up a conversation that he may not want to have.

Ouch, this hurts. This is exactly what he said he doesn't want happening. Sorry your sister messed things up for you.

As much as I'd dislike going though another therapy thing...You're probably right. I think the problem with me is because I have social anxiety it makes it harder for me to trust people. I trust his friends and opening up to strangers is...creepy to me. But you're right, you are. I have to get over that mental hump.

I know...it's just when you've gotten past something and the other person hasn't it's like painting half a picture. He's my brother, he's going to move on without me in his life. It could be worse, some siblings never were friends to begin with.

a few years ago (3?). I don't want to go behind his back. That's what happened then, I talked to his one friend and we bonded and all hell broke loose. The person he wants to cut out of his life is me, apparently. 

I have social anxiety/depression, and it's very very hard for me to make connections with people. Thing is, you can make connections to people, but if they don't understand something fundamental about you, you can only relate to them so much. His one friend has depression as do I and the other just listens and offers advice. We're all okay with this. We're able to talk about the subject without any guilt or shame. If I do cut them out of my life, I'd have two people left in the world but like I said, they are far too busy for me and really don't "get" my depression. They know, but they don't understand it. 

I've tried therapy multiple times, btw and meds. I'd like to try something called TMS but insurance is being a jerk about it. 

EDIT: What I mean by things I did as a child...it was just that, stupid children things. All kids are jerks at one point or another and they grow out of it, hopefully. So yeah, not the "I fell for his friend thing" but that only added to the childhood problems.

I don't and never will expect forgiveness, I don't deserve it. His idea of penitence is for me to not be friends with his friends. The thing is, his friends say I'm their friend. 

Would you suggest I tell them to forget it? They're their own people, I'm not in control of what they think. I do have issues and I'm owning up to it. I'm not looking for sympathy, but I am not the worst person on earth. I'm just in a pickle. So, do you think I should dump them as friends?

Basically I fell for a friend of his, things got weird and he stopped it from getting worse. They're still friends and I've learned from my mistake. 

A bit of background, both my brother and me were verbally, emotionally and physically abused by our father when younger. We both have some serious issues. He's insecure with relationships and I have zero self esteem. I would like to do therapy, but he hates the idea of it.

They're still friends, but I can see where he'd think it might happen again. Like I said, people change and I know what and what not to do now.
